recentItems.title: Aah Ko Chahiye | Asad Khan | Shujaat Khan | Mirza Ghalib
recentItems.description:
Tips Originals & Kumar Taurani present the new Hindi song “Aah Ko Chahiye.”

A beautiful and soulful ghazal inspired by the timeless poetry of Mirza Ghalib.

Enjoy the magical voice of Shujaat Khan and the soulful music composed by Asad Khan. This song beautifully captures the emotions of love, longing, and the timeless beauty of Ghalib’s words. ❤️🎶

Let this soulful melody touch your heart and take you into a world of love and poetry.
